symptom: MPR008 reported a loop overlapping the activity before/after it with "Each MDL statement that creates a canvas activity needs its own @position annotation", although every statement already had one (ako/mxcli#1839, mendixlabs/mxcli#1690)
cause: the rule worded every overlapping pair the same way; a LoopedActivity's box is sized by its body (stored Size, often 400px+ wide), so a loop at an ordinary 190px activity spacing reaches into its neighbour — a spacing problem, not a missing annotation
insight: A diagnostic that names one cause for a check with several sends users fixing the wrong thing. MPR008 already measured each box with its own stored size, so the loop case was detectable at no cost — the message just never asked which kind of box overlapped. Factoring the wording into a pure function made it unit-testable without an mpr.Reader (Check itself still needs one).
